name: Twin Colossals
summary: The Twin Colossals rise above northwestern Feralas, marking the way north into Desolace.

sections.title: Pillars of the Rainforest
sections.body: In western Feralas, the Twin Colossals rise above the forest. Travelers coming south from Desolace know these great cliffs at once. Their lower slopes meet the jungle and the lands near the Forgotten Coast, while their summits stand apart above the forest floor.

sections.title: Reaching the Heights
sections.body: No footpath climbs the sheer cliffs, but Marli Wishrunner helps travelers reach the eastern peak. A quiet pond rests atop the mesa, home to Diamond Head, an unusually large makrura. Kalin Windflight offers sturdy parachutes for the descent into the jungle canopy.

faq.q: Where are the Twin Colossals located?
faq.answer: The Twin Colossals rise in northwestern Feralas, beside the main road north into Desolace. The surrounding subzone reaches west toward the Forgotten Coast.

faq.q: How do you reach the top of the Twin Colossals?
aliases: get to top of twin colossi
faq.answer: The sheer cliffs cannot be climbed on foot. Marli Wishrunner helps travelers reach the eastern peak.

faq.q: Who lives on the eastern summit?
aliases: npc at top of twin colossals
faq.answer: Kalin Windflight sells parachutes on the eastern peak, where a deep pond is home to Diamond Head, an unusually large makrura.

faq.q: How do you get down safely from the top?
faq.answer: Kalin Windflight sells Colossal Parachutes atop the eastern summit. Travelers can leap from the cliffs and glide down into the Feralas jungle.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know these heights and nearby corrupted moonwells recall Feralas's ancient history. Shadows still creep into its wilderness.
